tables.heading: Forms of the `completion` level
rows: The initial record of the call shows an empty tool list and the session identity that F100-FR-230 asks for. For a harness whose stream has no initial record: an exact version pin together with the preflight of the harness adapter and the flag set of the call, open to a tested harness adapter only, and recorded as the weaker proof (F100-FR-230, case 3)

The critic runs in the working tree inside a read-only sandbox of the operating system and may read project files by itself. It cannot write, cannot run a command that writes and cannot reach the network
The call record shows the read-only sandbox mode, the network off, and the confirmation of the harness adapter that the withheld paths of §C.4 cannot be read
